name: Ancient White Dragon
speed: 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.

traits.Ice Walk: The dragon moves across icy surfaces without an ability check.
traits.Cold Breath: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone when it recharges.
traits.Frightful Presence: Each creature within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom save or be frightened.

actions.name: Bite
actions.note: The cold comes off it with the teeth.

actions.name: Cold Breath
actions.note: A 90-foot cone of frost. DC 22 Constitution save for half.
